integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone finite checks are distinct. The 2018 mean-square threshold is attributed to prior literature rather than claimed as new. Self-review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Single unstable scalar, exact zero-order hold, fixed real gain, independent exponential intersample times, no process or observation noise. Only a physical-time upper logarithmic exponent is claimed because intervals may contain isolated state zeros. The 1972 Beutler paper was read only at abstract level; equivalent earlier work remains possible.
title: The sharp almost-sure Poisson sampling threshold for an unstable scalar plant
